ns-01: I am not mind, intellect, ego, or memory; not ear, tongue, nose, or eyes; not space, earth, fire, or air. I am Shiva, of the form of consciousness-bliss.
ns-02: I am not the vital breath, nor the five winds, seven constituents, or five sheaths; not speech, hands, feet, or organs of generation and excretion. I am Shiva.
ns-03: I have neither hatred nor attachment, greed nor delusion, pride nor envy. I am not bound by dharma, artha, kama, or moksha. I am Shiva.
ns-04: Neither merit nor sin, joy nor sorrow; neither mantra, nor tirtha, Veda, nor sacrifice. I am not the enjoyment, the enjoyed, or the enjoyer. I am Shiva.
ns-05: Neither death nor fear of it, nor caste distinction; neither father, mother, nor birth; neither kin nor friend, teacher nor disciple. I am Shiva.
ns-06: I am without alternative or form; all-pervading, behind all senses. Neither attachment nor liberation is mine to be measured. I am Shiva, I am Shiva.
